answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I over-extended the metaphor. The milk is indeed organic, and the heat is necessary. I apologize for the pedantry. I shall eat this samosa with the gratitude it deserves.
answer.thought: Sunil’s correction is sharp and practical; I am indeed treating a transaction as a dialectic. The hunger is real, and the samosa is hot. I will eat this and drink the chai, acknowledging the body’s demands before I return to my papers.
